// why: `scripts/` was in no tsconfig at all, so `npm run typecheck` — which runs
--workspaces — never saw a line of it. The operator tool that writes plans
and seats by hand was therefore the one consumer of the StoredPlanId/PlanId
split that nothing policed, and it passed a stored `scale` into a PlanId
parameter: MINIMUM_SEATS['scale'] is undefined, Math.max(n, undefined) is
NaN, and NaN reached two integer columns.
`include` names files rather than globbing `scripts/**`, because several of
the older scripts do not compile under these settings today —
check-deploy.ts has an implicit any, rotate-root-key.ts has ArrayBufferLike
variance errors — and turning those into a build failure is a different
change from this one. A list that grows is honest about which files are
covered; a glob with a red build is a check somebody switches off.
